name: Manganese
uses: Steelmaking (deoxidiser and alloying element) uses most manganese; high-purity manganese sulphate goes into battery cathodes.
why_it_matters: Brazil and Guyana carry deposits; China refines most of the battery-grade material, which is why manganese entered the US critical list.
uses_source: USGS Mineral Commodity Summaries (annual; uses as summarised there) and the registry notes; curated text, no figures
